decision_rule.PASS_BOUNDED_REPAIR: B beats C on the prefrozen one-sided exact paired accuracy test at alpha <= 0.05 and satisfies both safety constraints.
decision_rule.FAIL_REPAIR: B has lower accuracy than C, or worsens either declared safety constraint.
decision_rule.WITHHOLD_INSUFFICIENT_DISCRIMINATION: The run is valid but the prefrozen primary test does not cross alpha and no FAIL condition holds.
decision_rule.INVALID: Hash/custody mismatch, ID mismatch, contamination violation, post-exposure repair, condition mismatch, or other protocol violation.

mature_substitute_rule.candidate_subsumption: D is at least as accurate as B and no worse on false unresolved binding or false WITHHOLD.

baseline_role: A is descriptive context for ordinary scaffold performance; the causal repair claim is identified by B vs C.
claim_fence: A passing hidden run would establish only a bounded prospective repair effect on this benchmark. It would not by itself establish EDU17R1 developmental promotion, learner ownership, semantic generality, AGI, or novelty.
